youtube.title: Leonardo da Vinci ghosted the Mona Lisa's husband 🖼️ #shorts
youtube.caption:
Leonardo da Vinci painted the Mona Lisa… and never delivered it. 🖼️

The husband paid. Leonardo moved to France with his wife's portrait.

Comment the reply YOU would've sent Leonardo 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: Florentine merchant Francesco del Giocondo commissioned a portrait of his wife Lisa around 1503. Leonardo kept working on it for years, took it to France and still had it when he died in 1519. Today it hangs in the Louvre.

#monalisa #leonardodavinci #davinci #arthistory #renaissance #historymemes #shorts
